title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-4n5v: merge conflict markers committed in fragment.rs
description:
## Severity: P0 (build break)

`rust/lichen-schc/src/fragment.rs` contains 15 unresolved merge conflict markers (`<<<<<<< Updated upstream`, `=======`, `>>>>>>> Stashed changes`) committed at lines 175-179, 187-209, 226-248, 305-324, 846-852. The file will not compile.

Additionally, the "Stashed changes" branch references undefined constants `_W_SHIFT` and `_FCN_MASK` at lines 206-207. The "Stashed changes" branch of `from_bytes` also uses different variable names and logic than the "Updated upstream" branch, creating broken control flow (e.g. `payload_len` used at line 217 is only set in the "Updated upstream" branch).

**Fix:** Re-resolve all 5 merge conflicts correctly. The "Updated upstream" branch appears to be the intended resolution path for most conflicts.
